headline: Last session: Indian markets fell for a fourth day as Nifty hit 22,600 amid surging crude oil prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Crude oil prices surging above $114 per barrel pressured Indian equities
Weak global market themes and concerns over US consumer sentiment
Significant profit drops in major companies like BPCL and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories
Profit booking leading to a 1,600-point weekly decline for the Sensex
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 ended the last session at 22,600, snapping a two-week winning streak
BPCL reported a 21.45% drop in Q2 net profit, citing fuel pricing issues
Adani Power saw a 142% surge in profit due to strong demand amid weak rains
JSW Steel posted a three-fold jump in quarterly profit and planned capacity expansions
summary: The Indian stock market ended the last session in the red, with the Nifty closing at 22,600. Surging crude oil prices and disappointing earnings from BPCL and Dr. Reddy's Laboratories pressured the indices. However, Adani Power and JSW Steel stood out with significant profit growth in their Q2 results.
